inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-lg
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use sparingly. Only for 'Active' states or the Timer ring.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for floating elements (modals, dropdowns).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border. In 'Swiss' mode, use thicker borders (2px) for active elements.

landing_hero.description: Modern conference room, clean lines, professional atmosphere.

team_collaboration.description: Top view of professionals discussing, implies strategy and oversight.

abstract_efficiency.description: Minimalist clock on wall, symbolizes time management.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Copy the CSS variables provided in 'colors.css_variables' to index.css to enable the theme.
3. USE SHADCN: Use the existing Shadcn components in /components/ui but override their styling with the 'Swiss Control Room' aesthetic (sharper corners, higher contrast).
4. TIMER IMPLEMENTATION: The timer is the heart of the app. Make it big, bold, and use the 'Urgent Orange' color.
5. AI REPORTS: Use a 'Glassmorphism' card style for the AI report section to make it feel futuristic and distinct from the manual data.
6. DARK MODE: Ensure all text colors have a dark mode variant (e.g., text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100).
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every interactive element (buttons, inputs, list items) for testing.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold with spacing (p-8, p-12).
No gradients on text unless it's a very specific brand header.
Always use 'Manrope' for headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the sidebar/header structure to ensure consistency.
